programme.title: Arctic
programme.desc: A plane crash occurs in the middle of the Arctic tundra. The only passenger on the plane is Overgard (Mads Mikkelsen), who manages to escape unscathed. At first, he believes that help will come soon and he persistently maintains some semblance of communication with the world by broadcasting a radio message about his situation. One day, hope for rescue appears when Overgard sees the outline of a helicopter on the horizon. However, it crashes into the ice. The girl found in the wreck motivates him to act. Feeling responsible for the stranger, despite the extreme conditions and numerous frostbites, the man decides to travel to a distant research station. The main character is played by the winner of the Palme d'Or for the 2012 film The Hunt... Iceland. 2018. adventure drama

programme.title: Spies in the snow
programme.desc: The creators of the documentary record funny and dramatic situations involving penguins, polar bears and sea otters. To be able to take a closer look at their heroes, they let spies into their ranks - dummy animals with cameras installed. They go to hard-to-reach, snowy Alaska. The first emissary, an artificial otter, is tasked with filming a mother and her newborn children. Despite the cold, otters can give birth even in the middle of winter. The young are protected by a down blanket. A human eye will accompany the family until the ice melts and the baby takes its first steps in independent life. Some of the material was obtained thanks to a camera placed... in an artificial snowball that moves using invisible elements. It is a true technological marvel, equipped with a self-aligning lens. The artificial bald eagle, on the other hand, uses drone technology. Designed to be indistinguishable from living birds, it allows you to observe nature from above... Great Britain. 2018. documentary film

programme.title: White winter
programme.desc: Viewers will see how animals living on the northern outskirts of the Alps are forced to change their daily lives... Germany. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Alaska: Four Seasons – Winter | E01
programme.desc: It's winter in Alaska. Animals must fight to survive. For seven months, they must demonstrate their ingenuity and resilience, and fight each other and the elements to stay alive. Great Britain. 2017. documentary series

programme.title: Alaska: Four Seasons – Spring | E02
programme.desc: Animals are programmed to reproduce and raise subsequent generations. Spring in Alaska is short: animals have less than two months to start a family and must avoid predators. Great Britain. 2017. documentary series

programme.title: Alaska: Four Seasons – Summer | E03
programme.desc: It's already summer in Alaska. The snow has melted, but the animals have no time to rest. Many of them still have young that they need to care for and find food for. Great Britain. 2017. documentary series

programme.title: Alaska: Four Seasons – Fall | E04
programme.desc: Autumn has come and it's getting colder. Wild animals are making final preparations for winter. Time is running out - autumn in the far north is short. Great Britain. 2017. documentary series

programme.title: Gladiators of the Animal World – River in the Jungle | E03
programme.desc: Some animals have a predisposition to fighting and facing enemies. With deadly weapons, cunning and tactics, they are born warriors of this world. The dense tropical jungle in America is teeming with life. It is inhabited by, among others, poisonous frogs, jaguars and stingrays - the gladiators of the animal kingdom. Australia. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Lion rules – Family arrangements | E04
programme.desc: In the floodplains of the lower reaches of the African Kuando River, called Chobe, a pride of lions dominates the local ecosystem. The clan, consisting of a dozen or so individuals, is ruled by two brothers and a brave female. The rebellious young lion Einstein stands out from them. Even though he should leave the family herd, he stubbornly sticks to his loved ones. With the arrival of the dry season, lions start fighting for survival. They try to protect their territory and offspring from rivals. When the cubs appear, Einstein decides to leave for good and start a new life. The flood waters are receding and game is returning to the banks of the Chobe River. There is a time of abundance in nature. While Callera and Tom Toma fight their enemies, Keeza and her pup escape. After many difficulties, Einstein finds a partner. South Africa. 2025. nature series

programme.title: Face to face – Crocodiles | E02
programme.desc: Rodolphe Guignard is a photographer and diver. He travels the world to meet predators and come face to face with them. He will see orcas, crocodiles, sharks and people living next to these majestic animals up close... France. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Dzika Kanada – Zima | S01E04
programme.desc: Four beautifully filmed and well-edited episodes that show the history of the part of North America that lies beyond the Arctic Circle. The documentary uses incredible aerial photography and astonishing time-lapse footage. They cover areas from the east coast to the west, from the plains to the wilderness, from vast expanses of grassy prairies to the cold, lifeless landscapes of the Arctic. This is the beating heart of true wild Canada. A story about the most difficult time of the year. Viewers will see an elusive lynx silently hunting American hares while a black bear and her cubs hibernate in the safety of their lair. USA, Great Britain, Austria, Canada. 2014. documentary series

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in Tsavo – Times of Prosperity | E01
programme.desc: In southern Kenya, as a result of the extraordinary cooperation of elephants and termites - the largest and smallest animals in Africa - a unique waterhole was created... USA. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Wild Vienna
programme.desc: Vienna is one of the most biologically active cities in the world. It is in the capital of Austria that you can see wildlife almost everywhere. The island of Donauinsel, located on the Danube, is designed to protect against flooding and is also a recreational area... Germany. 2024. documentary film

programme.title: Mysteries Of the Mekong: Laos: The Mountain Wilds (S1E2). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, 2017. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2017. S1, Ep2 «Mysteries Of the Mekong»…Laos is a country where most of it's western is demarcated by the Mekong River. Being one of the most pristine natural landscapes, Laos plays host to a diverse animal kingdom. It's topography is largely mountainous, and this steep terrain is blanketed by northern Laos's tropical rain and monsoon forests | Travel one of the mightiest waterways in the world as this journey along the Mekong River takes us across a cornucopia of diverse landscapes starting from its source high up in the Tibetan Plateau in China, We follow the meandering route through Laos and its western border with Thailand, one of the most pristine natural habitats on the planet dominated by abundant forests full of enchanting flora and fauna and a complex river system that feeds into the Mekong. From there, its path continues through Cambodia and, finally, into Vietnam where the majestic delta splits into nine channels that feed into the South China Sea. Each epsiode focuses on a particular section of the river and, along the way, we get to meet such creatures as snub-nosed monkeys, high-flying birds and never before filmed cave dwellers | Director: Cyril Eberle | Cast: Leila Monks

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs: The Scent Detectives (S1E5). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2019. S1, Ep5
programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2019. S1, Ep5 «Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs»…In this episode, dogs are using their remarkable scenting skills for life-saving conservation and pro-active environmental policing. In Canada, a team of canine detectives is sniffing out the destructive invasive zebra mussel which is wreaking havoc on lakes and rivers across North America. In Washington, a Lagotto Romagnolo is unearthing a rare delicacy in the forests – a job once done by pigs. In South Africa, a pair of Belgian Malinois – are tracking down the critically endangered Geometric Tortoise in an urgent mission to save the species. Whilst in the waters off Washington State, an Australian Cattle dog – is using his scenting skills to find orca scat in the ocean to help scientists understand why the resident pods are on the verge of extinction | It is often said that dogs are man's best friend but this documentary shows that they can also make excellent colleagues too. This series looks at the ways that the natural attributes of canines are being used in the world of work in all different sectors and how dogs are used to enhance and sometimes save the lives of humans. Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs travels across different continents to meet the four-legged friends who are performing key roles in crucial work. We see how dogs are integral to the work of the police, firefighters, scientists and more. Narrated by Victoria Stilwell | Director: Blake McGrow, Sean McDonnell

For them every animal counts, from small sea otter pups to giant sea lions | Director: Michael Sheehan | Cast: Tish Iceton

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School: Outbreak! (S2E8). Documentary about nature. England, 2019. S2, Ep8
programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2019. S2, Ep8 «Orangutan Jungle School»…The race is on to find Tulia and Zalipa, who are missing from Palas Island. Meanwhile, the vets keep a close eye on pregnant Dilla | Captivating documentary series that follows the work of the Nyaru Menteng Orangutan Rescue Centre in Borneo, Indonesia, which is the largest orangutan rehabilitation centre in the world. People who work here are dedicated to rescuing orangutans that have been displaced from their habitat or kept as illegal pets, and they do their best to help them adjust and teach them the skills necessary to survive on their own when they return to the jungle. Hear some incredible stories and follow the antics, triumphs and tragedies of a group of orphaned orangutans as they go through «Orangutan Jungle School» | Cast: Rebecca Parr

programme.title: Arctic Secrets: Waiting For Winter (S2E3). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, 2017. S2, Ep3
programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2017. S2, Ep3 «Arctic Secrets»…It's November at Cape Tatnam. Winter is coming to the lower Western shore of Hudson Bay. But the ice- which should be forming on Hudson Bay by now- is nowhere to be seen. 2016 has been the warmest year on record. In late November, the temperature is 10 degrees warmer than its average. Climate change is wreaking havoc across the North. At just below zero degrees Celsius, the sea cannot freeze | With its vast expanses of pristine white snow and clear glacial waters the landscapes of the Arctic are truly stunning, But, don't be fooled, for those who must live in this demanding environment, it is far from a winter wonderland. This documentary series takes a look at the people and animals for whom the Arctic is home. We see how Inuit tribes, orcas, polar bears and more survive the challenges of living in the severe climate of the northernmost part of our planet. The tribes and species of the Arctic have spent thousands of years learning how to adapt to the change of the seasons. They must now adapt to a new threat; the impact of climate change | Director: Allan Code

programme.title: Arctic Secrets: Waiting For Winter (S2E3). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, 2017. S2, Ep3
programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2017. S2, Ep3 «Arctic Secrets»…It's November at Cape Tatnam. Winter is coming to the lower Western shore of Hudson Bay. But the ice- which should be forming on Hudson Bay by now- is nowhere to be seen. 2016 has been the warmest year on record. In late November, the temperature is 10 degrees warmer than its average. Climate change is wreaking havoc across the North. At just below zero degrees Celsius, the sea cannot freeze | With its vast expanses of pristine white snow and clear glacial waters the landscapes of the Arctic are truly stunning, But, don't be fooled, for those who must live in this demanding environment, it is far from a winter wonderland. programme.title: Mysteries Of the Mekong: Laos: The Mountain Wilds (S1E2). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, 2017. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2017. S1, Ep2 «Mysteries Of the Mekong»…Laos is a country where most of it's western is demarcated by the Mekong River. Being one of the most pristine natural landscapes, Laos plays host to a diverse animal kingdom. It's topography is largely mountainous, and this steep terrain is blanketed by northern Laos's tropical rain and monsoon forests | Travel one of the mightiest waterways in the world as this journey along the Mekong River takes us across a cornucopia of diverse landscapes starting from its source high up in the Tibetan Plateau in China, We follow the meandering route through Laos and its western border with Thailand, one of the most pristine natural habitats on the planet dominated by abundant forests full of enchanting flora and fauna and a complex river system that feeds into the Mekong. From there, its path continues through Cambodia and, finally, into Vietnam where the majestic delta splits into nine channels that feed into the South China Sea. Each epsiode focuses on a particular section of the river and, along the way, we get to meet such creatures as snub-nosed monkeys, high-flying birds and never before filmed cave dwellers | Director: Cyril Eberle | Cast: Leila Monks

Australia, 1993, educational

programme.title: In the animal world. 19 p.
programme.desc: The fauna of our planet is vibrant and diverse, since the climatic conditions in different parts of it differ. How do animals, birds, fish, reptiles and insects hunt, reproduce and coexist in close proximity to humans? What habits are characteristic of different types of animals and how do they care for their offspring? An educational and exciting documentary project with fragments of the legendary show by Nikolai Drozdov. Great Britain, 2018, educational

programme.title: d/f In the skies

Spain, 2016

programme.title: d/s On the verge of extinction. Mediterranean

programme.desc: David Attenborough has been committed to preserving our environment for over six decades. Looking back on his life's work, the natural scientist shows the fatal effects of climate change. (Station info).

programme.title: Animal moms
programme.desc: Animal mothers have a very special connection with their offspring. Immediately after birth, they instinctively know what is needed to keep their little ones safe, fed and healthy. (Station info).

programme.title: Animal moms
programme.desc: Be careful. Young animals learn new skills in a playful way by taking after their mother. This is also sorely necessary in order to be able to survive alone in the wilderness. (Station info).

programme.title: Animal moms
programme.desc: Raising children is hard work and sometimes it gets too much for even the most patient mothers. What sophisticated methods do animal moms use to deal with bullies and tantrums? (Station info).

programme.title: Wonderful world of the Pacific & wild Antarctica
programme.desc: The flora and fauna of the southern hemisphere share a common past: millions of years ago, their continents were part of the supercontinent Gondwana. Orcas hunt sea lions not only at the South Pole, but also off the subtropical coasts.

programme.title: Right in the heart of Texas
programme.desc: A journey through the "Lone Star State": From the summit of Guadalupe Peak down to the Gulf of Mexico - the US state of Texas has an incomparable flora and fauna. (Station info).

programme.title: The discovery of giant dinosaurs
programme.desc: 40 meters long, weighing 77 tons: The Titanosaurus was probably the largest animal to ever walk the earth. In 2014, researchers discovered bones of a record specimen in Argentina. David Attenborough brings it to life again in this documentary.

programme.title: David Attenborough – My Life in the Wilderness
programme.desc: David Attenborough looks back on his unparalleled career as a filmmaker. The naturalist sheds light on how the filming of animal documentaries has changed over the decades. (Station info).

programme.title: Africa's hunters
programme.desc: A pack of wild dogs has Zambia's Luangwa Valley under its control - until a clan of hyenas emerges. Which four-legged friend will ultimately prevail in the fight for territory? (Station info).

programme.title: ĐẶC NHIỆM MÙ - BLIND WAR
programme.desc: Cựu đội trưởng SWAT Dong Gu bị mất thị lực do chấn thương trong một nhiệm vụ thất bại và anh buộc phải chịu trách nhiệm. programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION

programme.title: ĐẶC VỤ VÔ HÌNH 2 - THE GREY MEN 2
programme.desc: Ông trùm Hội Tam Hoàng Song tìm cách xóa sạch hình ảnh của mình và chiếm lấy ghế thị trưởng của Laika trong bối cảnh chế độ đang thay đổi. Anh ta phải đối mặt với sự thiếu hụt kinh phí mặc dù đã thông đồng với các quan chức, đồng thời được cánh tay phải và người thi hành án của mình phạm tội để tăng cường quỹ và quyền lực của anh ta. Ngay khi Song tin rằng thành công sắp đến thì động lực giữa ba người lại có một bước ngoặt bất ngờ…

programme.title: CÚ ĐẤM NGHĨA TÌNH - LOVE PUNCH
programme.desc: Võ sĩ tài năng Jia Yang bị vướng vào một cuộc chiến ngầm để trả nợ cho cha cô. Cô đánh mất khát vọng Olympic và biến mất khỏi thế giới quyền anh. 10 năm sau, huấn luyện viên Li Yue quyết tâm giúp cô thực hiện tâm nguyện của cha mình bằng cách trở lại sàn đấu. Khi niềm đam mê và nghĩa vụ va chạm, liệu Jia Yang có thể vực dậy giấc mơ quyền anh bị bỏ rơi của mình không?

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS

Hãy tham gia cùng các người mẫu nổi tiếng Indonesia Patricia và Chika khi họ khám phá những viên ngọc ẩn giấu và khung cảnh sôi động của thành phố, đắm mình trong sự tương phản đáng kinh ngạc và những rung cảm thời thượng.
